previousRule: The production checkout regression suite covered the personal sample offer and sample credit, but had no WELCOME5 route or database reservation check. The shared draft-order offer adapter changed the mixed-cart idempotency tag on retry.
newRule: Cover guest WELCOME5 pricing, sample credit, four product types, exact draft-order totals, and stable retries. Preserve the personal 10% eligibility rules and one percentage code per order. The private sample-credit reservation accepts the server-calculated 5% welcome saving in addition to eligible curtain sample credit.
reason: The owner requested a useful welcome signup popup and a cart entry point. A new mixed-cart test exposed a retry identity conflict, and the existing private sample-credit reservation would reject a valid WELCOME5 plus credit checkout without a scoped migration.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested implementation of this welcome offer. The protected release still requires Nylon1 to post the exact current PR head approval comment before merge or production deployment.
